stories.S1: Priya swaps the battery connector to XT60 in a firmware-channel post (power is EVT, no ECO); it clashes with the DVT base casting slot and is resolved with a pigtail.
stories.S2: Mei reports the DVT slew bearing lot slipping ~3 weeks in supply-chain; Tom approves a deviation to build first units on EVT spares and announces the schedule risk to the team.

messages.text: pulled the logs from the e-stop tests: pack current spikes to ~38A on decel for ~200ms. the XT30 on the brick is only rated 30A and its getting toasty 🔥 swapping to XT60 on the PDB + the pack lead in rev 3. power's still EVT so no ECO needed, just doing it
just saw this 😬 an XT60 is ~16mm wide, the cable pass-thru slot in the base casting is 12mm. base is DVT and the 120 castings are already on PO. <@U_TOM> that'd be a casting ECO + pattern change
ah didnt think about the slot. could do a ~10cm pigtail so the XT60 sits inside the battery bay and only the wire goes thru. no casting change
do the pigtail, no ECO on the casting. <@U_MEI> fyi base casting PO stays as is, nothing to tell the foundry
rev 3 board w/ the pigtail sent to fab, back in ~8 days
anyone have a usb-c to barrel adapter? the demo laptop charger walked off again
my desk, 2nd drawer. bring it back pls 🙏

ugh, bearing vendor just emailed: the DVT lot of the big lazy susan for the base (300mm crossed roller) failed incoming hardness check. re-heat-treat pushes ship from 10/9 to ~10/30, so ~3 wk slip. we only have 4 EVT spares in the cage
thats right on the critical path once the TMC9660s land. <@U_RAVI> can we build the first DVT units on the EVT spares?
EVT rings are the older 4-pt contact ones, preload's diff but same bolt pattern. ok for the first 4 units, would need to reshim each like unit 3. rest have to wait for the real ones
ok. EVT bearing on a DVT build is a deviation not an ECO, I'll sign it. Mei pls push them for a partial shipment
asked, they think ~40 pcs by 10/16 if we take them unpainted

<!channel> heads up: slew bearings for DVT are slipping ~3 wks (vendor heat treat issue). plan is first 4 DVT units build on EVT spares under a deviation, rest when the partial ships ~10/16. DVT build date still hinges on the TMC9660s too, Sara I'll have a real date for you mon
ok thx, need it mon latest. customer keeps asking
bandsaw blade snapped 🪚 new one comes tues, use the hacksaw til then
